source_evidence:
A subscription-based fee is a set, recurring fee that you pay for a particular service, typically on a monthly basis.
An asset-based fee is commonly paid at the end of each quarter. As the value of the assets held in your investment account change, the dollar amount paid in fees also changes.
question: How does a subscription-based advisory fee differ from an asset-based fee?
answer: A subscription-based fee is a set recurring charge, typically monthly. An asset-based fee is calculated as a percentage of the assets in your account, so the dollar amount you pay changes as the account’s asset value changes.
